//MusicPlayer
package Practice;
import java.util.*;
public class MusicPlaylistManager {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		String[] song= {"Faasle", "Zaroorat", "Jeene Laga Ho"};
		System.out.print("Songs: Faasle, Zaroorat, Jeene Laga Ho");
		
		int choice=0;
		
		while(choice!=4) {
			System.out.println("=== Music Playlist Manager ===");
			System.out.println("1-> Play all songs");
			System.out.println("2-> Play a song by index");
			System.out.println("3-> Play a song by name");
			System.out.println("4-> Exit");
			
			System.out.print("Enter your choice: ");
			choice=sc.nextInt();
			
			switch(choice) {
			case 1:
				System.out.print("Playing all songs");
				for (String songs : song) {
                    System.out.println("Playing: " + song);
                }
                break;
                
			case 2:
				System.out.print("Enter song index (0 to " + (song.length - 1) + "): ");
                int index = sc.nextInt();
                if (index >= 0 && index < song.length) {
                    System.out.println("Playing: " + song[index]);
                } else {
                    System.out.println("Invalid index!");
                }
                break;
                
			case 3:
				System.out.print("Enter song name to search: ");
                String search = sc.next();
                boolean found = false;
                for (String songs : song) {
                    if (songs.equalsIgnoreCase(search)) {
                        System.out.println("Playing: " + songs);
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!found) {
                    System.out.println("Song not found!");
                }
                break;
                
			case 4:
				System.out.println("Exiting Music Player. Goodbye!");
                break;

            default:
                System.out.println("Invalid choice! Try again.");
			} 
			
		}
		sc.close();
	}

}
